public/vendor/googlecloud-logo.svg — the Google Cloud mark used on the film thumbnail (`--mark gcp`)
==================================================================================================

WHAT IT IS
  The Google Cloud mark as Simple Icons draws it: a single-colour silhouette of Google's cloud
  logo, not Google's own four-colour artwork. Used by scripts/thumb-film.mjs for `--mark gcp`,
  embedded AS SUPPLIED: never re-traced, re-proportioned or otherwise altered. The file carries no
  fill, so the script paints it in the colour Simple Icons publishes for the brand, #4285F4. That
  is the same mark and colour graphl-flow draws for its `gcp` icon key in the scenes.

WHERE IT CAME FROM
  Copied byte for byte on 2026-11-03 from simple-icons 16.36.0 (icons/googlecloud.svg), a
  dependency of graphl-flow. Simple Icons lists its source as https://cloud.google.com and gives
  no licence for this icon.

  Simple Icons releases its project under CC0, but its DISCLAIMER says that does not mean every
  icon is CC0. The mark is Google's trademark whatever the file's licence.

THE TERMS THAT APPLY
  Google's brand guidelines govern its logos. Read their current text before publishing: they
  are the authority, and this note is not. The cover must not suggest that Google produced,
  sponsored or endorsed the course. GraphL's FULL COURSE badge and the "data engineering" line
  are the course's own identity, and nothing on it says otherwise.

  If Google's terms call for its official logo instead of a silhouette, vendor that file here,
  unaltered, and point `MARKS.gcp` at it.

  `--mark tile` (public/favicon.svg, this repo's own mark) needs none of this.
